pr.description:
The PR view (#174), built slice by slice on `t3/build-pr-view-feature` and merged into `main` here as one unit.

**This PR is also the recorded fixture.** It analyses itself: v1 is recorded at its current head, slice 4's code is pushed to it, and v2 is recorded at the new head (#178, "The recording"). Merge it with a merge commit only, so the analysed SHAs stay reachable from `main`.

## Slices
- [x] 1. The analysis crate: schema, validator, migrations and the agent's tools (#175, merged via #188)
- [x] 2. The analysis run and its API (#176, merged via #189)
- [x] 3. The PR panel's Analyse button (#177, merged via #190)
- [x] 4. Fixtures: the recorded analysis, fixture PRs, the tiler and the server gates (#178), merged via #192 (v1 committed; v2 to record at this head)
- [ ] 5. The beghu CLI (#179)
- [ ] 6. Our layout (#180)
- [ ] 7. The PR view: route, loading and panel (#181)
- [ ] 8. The canvas (#182)
- [ ] 9. Purposes: the walkthrough, conflicts and the fold plan (#183)
- [ ] 10. Path (#184)
- [ ] 11. The order of actions lens (#185)
- [ ] 12. The phone and touch (#186)

Each slice's issue holds its test evidence and the decisions made on gaps in the spec.

## Still to check against real GitHub
- Whether the App's `pull_requests: read` covers `GET /pulls/{n}/commits` without `contents: read` (#177). If it doesn't, the button reads "PR view · outdated" with no count.
- A real agent taking a button prompt through to an accepted upload, which is the "Done when" of #176 and #177.
